description: V0.5a recorded-decision replay: the LLM agent's decisions from the live smoke test (docs/benchmark/v05a-dev/llm-decisions.jsonl) submitted again through the protocol by the agent's replay mode, without any model, beside the no-op baseline, under the smoke test's scenario, seed, horizon and cadence. Deterministic: a rerun gives the same files. Run from the repository root.
seedPlan: The V0.5a smoke test's seed (docs/benchmark/v05a-dev/config.json), so that the recorded decisions belong to the run.

external.description: the LLM agent (agents/llm/llm_agent.py, llm-agent v1) in replay mode: the live smoke test's recorded decisions, each checked against its decision point and digests; no model is called
